notes: Both לְs of the double indirect object are unrepresented: the ASV writes a bare object (*commanded the people*) and then a relative clause (rule 40).
The relative of *that dwelt* stays with the articleless participle under rule 41 rather than being marked added under rule 55.
*themselves* is kept inside יֶחֶזְקוּ's rendering as the reflexive of the English idiom; marking it an added object under rule 44 was the competing reading.
